title: Common emergency: inferior STEMI with possible right-ventricular involvement

symptoms: Sudden severe chest pressure with nausea, sweating and light-headedness for 45 minutes.
Persistent symptoms at rest. Learner should recognize a time-critical presentation; the scenario is not designed to teach procedural steps.
medications: Fictional medication list incomplete at arrival; medication reconciliation pending
presentation.vitals: HR 52 bpm; BP 92/60 mmHg; RR 22/min; SpO2 95% room air; cool extremities and diaphoresis; reassessment required.
presentation.initial_ecg_summary: Inferior ST elevation pattern in II, III and aVF with reciprocal change in I/aVL in the synthetic tracing. Right-sided leads are pending in the initial data.
presentation.initial_troponin_summary: Initial hs-cTn may be non-diagnostic early; repeat trend rises above the fictional assay threshold. Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL; potassium 4.3 mmol/L; CBC without major abnormality.
presentation.notice: Synthetic educational scenario only; pending clinical review. Simulation tier is not a validated clinical risk score.

allergy_history.reaction: No known allergy documented initially; verify with patient/records
